title: プロジェクトデザイン特別科目(工業デザイン(3Dスタイリング))(後学期冬)
subtitle: Special Subject - Design Project(Product design(3D Styling))
courseType:
(Provided by all courses)
Liberal Arts Courses
Transdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal: The aim is to develop 'design engineers' who have a base of engineering skills and have also acquired design skills. The advantage of design engineering is the craftsmanship-like "integration of the creator's will " through the fusion of professions. It also speeds up product development by simultaneously solving problems and designing the implementation of functional and external components and their intersections. The lessons focus on learning CAD techniques for styling the exterior of devices, with the aim of promoting practical prototyping with 3D data.
advice: To understand basic knowledge of 3D modeling of industrial products and to learn CAD operations for creating their external shapes. Theme: Curved surface modeling. Software: RHINOCEROS 1.Knowledge of 3D modeling "Scale", "Fillet", "Analysis of lines/surfaces", "Wireframes", etc. 2.CAD operation 1) Polygonal modeling Intuitive modeling method for idea generation. Students learn CAD operations by creating replica shapes of existing products. 2) Surface modeling Organic and dimensionally defined modeling method with 3D wireframes. Students learn CAD operations by creating replica shapes of existing products.
requiredKnowledge: 1) No specific prior knowledge is required. 2) Students with an interest in design or design engineering are targeted. 3) Will use the 3D modeling software RHINOCEROS (version 7) 4) Watching tutorials on basic operations is recommended.

activityGoals.body: To understand basic knowledge of 3D modeling of industrial products.
To be prepared to make functional and aesthetic design proposals.
Be able to create the overall shape of the subject in RHINOCEROS polygonal modeling mode.
Be able to create the overall shape of the subject in RHINOCEROS surface modeling mode.
Be able to use analysis tools to adjust the geometry.
Be able to visually express the overall shape and the design of the subject to a third party.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) Understood knowledge of 3D modeling and CAD operation method well. 2) Be able to create the equivalent shape of the subject without stopping in polygonal modeling mode. 3) Understood knowledge of the 3D wireframes and be able to create the equivalent shape of the subject in surface modeling mode with aesthetic analysis. 4) Be able to clearly communicate to a third party with CG images made by the 3D data in rendering mode.
achievementLevels.standard: 1) Understood basic knowledge of 3D modeling and CAD operation method. 2) Be able to create the overall shape of the subject in polygonal modeling mode. 3) Understood knowledge of the 3D wireframes and be able to create the overall shape of the subject in surface modeling mode. 4) Be able to make CG images using the 3D data in rendering mode
